name: Melos action
description: Setup Melos for you GitHub workflow

melos-version.description: The Melos version to make available on the path

dart-version.description: The dart version to pass to dart-lang/setup-dart action used for publishing, this helps to avoid race condition when having flutter SDK setup with the version d

run-bootstrap.description: Whether bootstrap should run or not (default: true)

bootstrap-no-example.description: Whether to pass the --no-example flag to melos bootstrap, this helps to avoid race conditions in flutter packages, where pub get can be executed on the example

enforce-lockfile.description: Whether the versions in the lockfiles should be enforced (default: false)

run-versioning.description: Whether packages should be versioned (default: false)

run-versioning-prerelease.description: Whether packages should be versioned as a prerelease (default: false)

run-versioning-graduate.description: Whether packages should be versioned with graduating prereleases to stable (default: false)

include-private.description: Whether to include or exclude packages with `publish_to: "none"` (default: false)

publish-dry-run.description: Whether packages should be dry-run published (default: false)

tag.description: Whether packages should be tagged and pushed to the repository. Packages are tagged as `my_package-vX.Y.Z`, except for the root package of a workspace with `use

publish.description: Whether packages should be published to pub.dev (default: false)

create-release.description: Whether a GitHub release should be created for the package related to the tag that triggered the workflow. The release notes are extracted from the package's CH

release-prerelease.description: Whether the created GitHub release should be marked as a prerelease. By default this is detected automatically from the version (any version containing a `-`, e

create-pr.description: Whether a PR should be created with the versioning changes (default: false)

pr-title.description: The title to use for the PR created when `create-pr` is true (default: "chore(release): Publish packages")

pr-body.default: Prepared all packages to be released to pub.dev
pr-body.description: The body to use for the PR created when `create-pr` is true (default: "Prepared all packages to be released to pub.dev")

close-existing-pr.description: Whether open release PRs previously created by this action should be closed, and their branches deleted, when a new PR is created with `create-pr` (default: tru

token.description: Token to use when creating the PR. Use a PAT or GitHub App token to trigger workflows on the created PR (default: GITHUB_TOKEN)

git-email.description: The email to use when committing changes

git-name.description: The name to use when committing changes
